set.body: Turn the spatial-frame identity into an interpretable demonstration rather than a normalization slogan. Compare overlapping center-assigned/local-normalized and coverage-corrected conservative frames; show the concrete double-counting or mass-allocation error prevented; and verify the local sum against a mass-preserving global measurement. Acceptance: multiple radii or overlap regimes, declared tolerance, independent oracle, clear feature-additive fixed-metric scope, explicit exclusion of unsupported non-diagonal learned metrics, and an interpretive question the conservation receipt answers.
set.title: Gate 4: make conservative spatial accounting scientifically operational
